video_title: Are The Warriors & Lakers Legitimate Threats In The West? + Underrated Trade For Thunder

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Stephen Curry's historic offensive production and impact on the Warriors
quotes.excerpt: Steph Curry now has 16 of those, LeBron James next in NBA history with 15, Michael Jordan 12.
quotes.quote: Steph Curry's last five games: 44 points, 8 rebounds, 6 assists in a win over Minnesota. 31 points, 4 rebounds, 6 assists in a win over the Lakers. 34 points, 6 rebounds, 7 assists in a win against the Suns. 29 points, 1 rebound, 4 assists in a win over Miami. 41 points, 5 rebounds, 6 assists in an overtime win against the Magic. He is averaging more than a point a minute so far this year. He has 16 of those 40-point games since turning 35. LeBron James next in NBA history with 15, Michael Jordan 12.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Kristaps Porzingis's decision to step away from basketball
quotes.excerpt: I've made the decision to prioritize my health and step away from the game I love.

text_blocks.speaker: Brian Windhorst
text_blocks.text: Kristaps Porzingis put out a statement basically saying: 'This season I was really looking forward to running it with this group, but as I ramped up, my body didn't respond the way I anticipated. I'm doing good, but I know what it takes, and I'm not where I want to be to perform at the level that I expect from myself. At this point, I've made the decision to prioritize my health and step away from the game I love. In this situation, I want to show the utmost respect for the Golden State Warriors and work with them to find a solution that makes sense.'

text_blocks.speaker: Tim MacMahon
text_blocks.text: It's effectively announcing his retirement. Don't hold your breath for me to be back on the floor.

quotes.speaker: Tim MacMahon
quotes.summary_phrase: Warriors' salary cap and tax situation regarding Kristaps Porzingis
quotes.excerpt: They are 20,410,000 over the tax. So if Porzingis's contract is just poof off the books
quotes.quote: They are 347 grand and change from the second apron. They are 20,410,000 over the tax. So if Porzingis's contract is just poof off the books, they could easily duck under the tax.

quotes.speaker: Tim MacMahon
quotes.summary_phrase: Luka Doncic's MVP-level performance and Mavericks' offensive reliance
quotes.excerpt: Luka has joined Wilt as the only guy who's averaging 40-plus points per game after nine games.
quotes.quote: Luka has joined Wilt as the only guy who's averaging 40-plus points per game after nine games. Wilt did it twice, of course. While he's averaging whatever, 8 and 8, he's averaging basically 40 points, 8 rebounds, 8 assists. And then tonight, Luka gets a rest, I think they called it back soreness, I assume it's just not going to play both ends of a back-to-back, and Austin Reaves goes bonkers and they get a big-time win on the road in Detroit.

quotes.summary_phrase: Thunder's trade for Nique Clifford and front office strategy

text_blocks.speaker: Brian Windhorst
text_blocks.text: The Thunder traded up to get Nique Clifford. I don't think this played a significant role, however, for people who are in our job, I think this is worth pointing out. Todd Ramiszar is Nique Clifford's agent. Nique Clifford wanted out of Sacramento and Todd Ramiszar was trying to help get him out of Sacramento as a good agent does.

text_blocks.speaker: Tim MacMahon
text_blocks.text: Todd Ramiszar and Mike Simonet on both these guys. He wanted to get him to a place where he had a chance to be developed.

quotes.speaker: Tim MacMahon
quotes.summary_phrase: Ben Simmons's role and health impact on the Nets
quotes.excerpt: Ben Simmons was going to start for them. That's a fact.
quotes.quote: Ben Simmons was going to start for them. That's a fact. They don't want to run up Alex Caruso's minutes because they need Alex Caruso to be fresh come playoff time. They'll run his minutes up in the playoffs. They're not going to do it over the course of the 82-game season.

quotes.speaker: Tim MacMahon
quotes.summary_phrase: Impact of new NBA anti-tanking rules on trade deadline behavior
quotes.excerpt: I think it complicates the buyout negotiations, right? Because before, yeah, sure, we'll let you go.
quotes.quote: I think it complicates the buyout negotiations, right? Because before, yeah, sure, we'll let you go, save a little bit of money, and lose a bunch of games as and improve our lottery odds, make sense for everybody. Now, to lose a bunch of games doesn't improve your lottery odds. So I just think it complicates. Although it's a weird thing, you look at some of the worst teams in the league, a bunch of them don't control their own picks.
